faq.q: How much does Jurewitz Law Group Injury & Accident Lawyers charge?
faq.a: Jurewitz Law Group Injury & Accident Lawyers publishes a contingency fee, which means the fee is a share of what the case recovers and there is nothing to pay if it recovers nothing. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does Jurewitz Law Group Injury & Accident Lawyers offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. Jurewitz Law Group Injury & Accident Lawyers publishes a free initial consultation. It publishes material in Spanish.

json_ld_descriptions: Jurewitz Law Group Injury & Accident Lawyers is a nationally recognized personal injury firm fighting for accident victims across California and Florida, with offices in San Diego, North County, and Tampa. Known for securing life-changing results, including a $19.15 million settlement for a mother and daughter killed by a tractor-trailer, more than triple the insurer’s initial $6 million offer—the firm has recovered over $250 million for clients in catastrophic injury and wrongful death cases. Led by founder Ross Jurewitz, recipient of the Litigator Award™, a 10/10 AVVO rating, and media features in Time, Newsweek, and CNN, the team combines aggressive negotiation, fearless trial advocacy, and deeply personal client care. Offering free consultations and working exclusively on a contingency fee basis, Jurewitz Law Group delivers relentless, results-driven representation to help clients rebuild after life-altering accidents.
